## Meso 0.3.5
### New
- **Tabs & TouchPlay plugins**: Added the screen-edge **Tabs** drawer uniting browser tabs, app windows, AI chats, projects, categories, and URL deduplication, plus **TouchPlay** for multi-touch trackpad instruments, **Compression**, document-to-Markdown conversion, and individual switches for tool plugins installed straight from the store using packages carried inside Meso.app. - **Image Translation & local models**: Translate screen selections, windows, or images in place with bilingual hover cards and optional complex-layout analysis; added on-device writing, translation, and transcription models downloaded on demand, alongside new cloud and on-device providers. - **Teleprompter & recording upgrades**: Added a capture-invisible Teleprompter with voice sync, notch mode, and SRT export, plus recording resolution and FPS caps, custom cursor skins, pause power saving, a 12-color presentation pen, and an adjustable magnifier. - **Notch HUD & Translucent look**: Added a modular Notch HUD across displays for Now Playing, Calendar with meeting join, notices, batteries, and quick actions, and a new Translucent window style across Meso, Studio, and plugin windows. - **Devices, Voice & Feedback**: Added Virtual Keyboard mode supporting password fields and shared held modifiers across keyboards, VIA/Vial keymap editing, MX Master 4 force sensing and haptics, trackpad curves and gestures, interactive 3D device views, voice rewrite over selected text with Dictation History, in-app Feedback, and Feature Usage stats.
### Improved
- **Quick Notes, Clipboard & Launcher**: Upgraded Quick Notes to a block editor with document import and Connected Services; added Space preview and in-place editing in Clipboard; refined Launcher IME handling, scrolling, and matching. - **Speed & efficiency**: Faster Meso, Studio, and CLI startup with lower memory use through layered frameworks, GPU-accelerated recording export, and smoother high-refresh scrolling with a live Scroll Monitor. - **Controls & clarity**: Clearer error feedback when actions, plugins, or device writes fail, drag-to-reorder lists, faster Studio page switching, and no stray Dock bounce.
### Fixed
- Fixed system audio muted during dictation not restoring after a restart, and clarified paused remaps while Secure Input is active. - Fixed inverted mouse scroll direction resetting when Smooth scrolling is off, MX Master 4 haptics muting after wake, and high-refresh scroll glide glitches. - Fixed Clipboard preview stealing keyboard focus and crashes when previewing pictures or files. - Fixed cloud sync edge cases on interrupted or unreadable writes, Settings losing scroll position on subpage return, and multiple UI and refresh races.

## Meso 0.3.4 Beta
This beta tries the plugin store's online catalog. It has had less testing than 0.3.3: install it only if you're happy to report what breaks.
**Plugin store** - Plugins you don't have are listed under More Plugins, with Install on each tile. A plugin that came with Meso and that you removed can be installed again from here. - A newer version of an installed plugin shows Update on its tile, and a line at the top of the store lists them with Update All. - Plugins update by themselves once Meso reads the catalog, after launch and once a day. A plugin that's busy, downloading or recording, updates once it's done. Turn this off in the store's ··· menu, which also checks for updates now. - Downloads show their progress on the tile and on the plugin's page.
**Updates** - This build follows the Beta channel and updates itself to later betas.

## Meso 0.3.3
- Keyboards and mice on a 2.4 GHz receiver are found again, and their shortcuts work. - Smooth scrolling, scroll direction, speed and tilt settings apply to mice again. - Add Device shows a receiver nothing has been heard through yet, and finds its mouse when you move it. - Keyboards follow the mouse to the computer that has it, not the next channel. - Meso says when a keyboard leaves, a controller arrives, or key and pointer handling stops. Each notice has its own switch in Settings › Devices and starts off; cable alerts now live there too. - Granting Input Monitoring after launch takes effect without restarting. - Seven crashes fixed in Meso, Studio, Notes and the CLI. - Shelf edits, note drafts, clipboard originals, plugin updates and settings survive interruptions and failed writes. - Wording polished in all five languages.

## Meso 0.3.2
- Meso Studio no longer quits as it opens on macOS 26. - Wording polished in all five languages.
